topic: Directional and Brake Light Control System Signals
row_semantics: Each row represents a specific signal or status related to the control and monitoring of vehicle directional and brake lights.

core_entities.description: Controls the activation of brake lights.

core_entities.name: DircnLghtMdSts
core_entities.description: Indicates the mode status of directional lights (enabled/disabled).

core_entities.name: BrkLghtFltSta

engineering_interpretation: This table defines the control signals, status indicators, and fault detection mechanisms for vehicle directional and brake lights across different controller units. It is used to verify the correct operation and fault reporting of these lighting systems in response to various control commands.
